policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

task_information: Centers, quadratic matrices and the change clock belong to the script-owned simulator. They never enter public TaskSpec/context, initial controls or candidates. Online calls1..8 use the initial function; call9/global41 is the first changed vector. Evaluation uses each final function with the original task seed and a separately offset noise stream.
comparison: Three fixed arms share each task's32 actually purchased initialization vectors and use32 new calls each. Native SC-KG uses its original optimizer with only the paid-data initialization hooks. Frozen0.52 is loaded exclusively from the old immutable package. The no-online-goal-research ablation permits the first objective-model fit, then freezes that fitted hypothesis and disables objective monitoring/re-entry; it retains goal exploration, GP/HVD updating, prior adoption and identical constraint research.
additional_method: After the three-arm control experiment, append the independently frozen interaction candidate method on the same nine tasks. It adds control-group-held-out cross-term candidates and callable programs plus joint-optimum nomination, with fitting and solve work charged. Its source copies frozen0.52 and changes only objective_research.py, decision_experiments.py and the budget argument in objective_reentry.py. Reuse all initial and evaluator vectors; do not rerun controls.
accounting: Each seed has two distinct initial functions, so six shared32-vector prefixes cost192. Nine tasks times three control arms times32 online calls cost864. Nine final-function evaluations of128 vectors cost1152, totaling2208. The interaction arm adds288 online calls, for2496 across all four arms. Initialization research computation, online Hegel model work, native KG timings and evaluation calls are separate. Preserve every regression and failure.
limitations: Nine fixed synthetic cases diagnose objective change and representation gaps. These are shared-initialization conditional comparisons, not broad agent benchmarks. The three profiles and all centers were fixed before observing outcomes. Interaction development uses these tasks and must not be described as independent confirmation.
